title: Negotiating Contracts Successfully
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the skills, knowledge, and strategies required to effectively negotiate throughout the contract life cycle. By mastering negotiation techniques, participants will learn to foster positive relationships between parties and achieve mutually beneficial, win-win outcomes. The course also delves into best practices for negotiating key aspects such as scope of work, terms and conditions, claims, variation orders, and dispute resolution.
audience: This course is ideal for professionals involved in contract and business negotiations, including those managing procurement activities for goods, services, manpower, materials, or supplies.
methodology: Participants will engage in a variety of individual and group exercises designed to reinforce key contract negotiation concepts. The course includes case studies, role-playing activities, and interactive presentations, followed by discussions to solidify understanding. Pre- and post-course assessments are conducted to track progress.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the critical role of negotiation in contract development and the risks of poor negotiation practices.
Apply core concepts of effective negotiations, including problem-solving, communication, and structured planning, to achieve win-win solutions.
Plan and execute formal contract negotiations across different phases of the contract life cycle.
Address key provisions in the scope of work using collaborative negotiation techniques.
Effectively manage and resolve contractual claims and change orders to prevent disputes.
Identify and utilize various negotiation tactics to achieve desired outcomes.
